d: Prime Hub is one of Oman’s leading OOH Media Houses, specializing in outdoor, digital, and experiential advertising.
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accountant to join our growing team and support the company’s financial operations across multiple projects and business units.
q: Minimum 3 years of accounting experience, preferably within advertising, media, events, or related industries.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Good experience with accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure.
Currently based in Oman is preferred.
r: Manage daily accounting operations and bookkeeping activities.
Prepare invoices, payment vouchers, purchase orders, and financial documents.
Monitor accounts payable and receivable, and follow up on outstanding payments.
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation.
Prepare monthly financial reports, reconciliations, and cash flow reports.
Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and expense tracking.
Coordinate with external auditors and support VAT and compliance requirements.
Monitor financial transactions across projects, suppliers, and clients.
Support management with financial analysis and operational reporting.
x: Be part of one of Oman’s fastest-growing media companies.
Work on high-profile projects and national advertising campaigns.
Career growth opportunities and professional development.
